preflightProtocol: Before each family evaluation, sourced private/source-corpus-environment.txt, exported MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR="$RCAP_BUNDLE_EXTRACT", unset OFFICIAL_FORMS_SOURCE_DIR, and executed node scripts/verify-packet-build-environment.mjs --family <family> --branch codex/v3-independent-packet-verification.
independentMethods: Recomputed every pinned corpus-source SHA-256 and byte length from MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR.
Recomputed every tracked canonical/boundary PDF SHA-256 and every raster SHA-256.
Loaded tracked artifacts read-only with pdf-lib to verify page counts and decoded content streams to observe fixture values.
Inspected canonical/boundary rasters at original resolution; stopped each row at the first WEC-6 failure or unresolved legal determination.
Did not rebuild, repair, mutate, or substitute any packet source or artifact.
